question: Upon whose heart is the fierce goddess established?
premises: The goddess is described as established in position.
Her position is located upon a heart.
That heart belongs to the great god in corpse-form.
inference: The fierce goddess stands upon the heart of the great god appearing in corpse-form.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the corpse-form great god is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: She stands upon the heart of the great god in the form of a corpse.
